text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Tenno Sho (Spring).
Looking ahead to the upcoming Japan Cup—
Mihono Bourbon gathered every piece of material on Tokai Teio she could find, compiling information including races she had previously watched.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Beginning input.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Stretching her legs with supple grace to pull away, and she crosses the finish line!
Strong, so very strong, Tokai Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A comfortable win by 3 lengths...
Looking completely composed in both body and mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Could this truly be called raw talent?

Tokai Teio, known by the moniker "Emperor,"
is the Double Crown Umamusume from two years ago.

"With natural talent and unyielding effort,
she climbed to the very top of the Twinkle Series."

Ever since her injury after the Japan Derby,
her results had been unstable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Beginning playback of the recordings.
Inputting "Tokai Teio's" data.

Even as she began reviewing her records with apparent determination,
Mihono Bourbon's face gradually clouded over.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Now then, this year's Kikuka Sho is about to begin!
It's shaping up to be an immensely thrilling race, but—”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Tokai Teio, who was widely expected to become an undefeated
Triple Crown Umamusume, has unfortunately had to withdraw
due to an injury."

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"‘It's such a pity. I really wanted to see it.
Tokai Teio's running.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having missed her shot at an undefeated Triple Crown, Tokai Teio
continues her rigorous training today in preparation for her comeback."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"The Kikuka-sho was unfortunate, sure.
But that doesn't mean it's the end!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "It starts from here! From now on!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: ""Tokai Teio made a successful comeback from last year's fracture and was showing brilliant form in the Twinkle Series, however—""

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "It appears another breakdown has occurred."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Teio got injured again!?
Is she gonna be okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"'Stronger Umamusume keep appearing one after another...
I guess Teio's era is over now.'"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not yet...!
It's only just beginning...!
Afterward, having now made a successful return to racing, and—

After speaking of her goal to run in the Japan Cup...
the video recording came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...This is not the first time I have watched the footage
of achieving the Double Crown. However, far more vividly than before—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was able to truly understand her 'joy'
with real conviction.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And just as well... I can understand
the "frustration" she feels right now.
Saying that, Mihono Bourbon gripped my hand tightly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Is she "all right" right now?

Still, there's no use worrying about it.
First, I need to focus on winning myself.
When I told her that, she gave a small nod, looking a bit bewildered.
Afterward, heading toward the track for a change of pace—
There was Tokai Teio, doing her training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaaa———h!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

"Perhaps she's clocking her time,
as she bolts ahead with all the intensity of an actual race."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, I won't lose, I won't lose...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The one who's gonna win the Japan Cup is meee!
With a roaring shout, Tokai Teio surged across the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...
Alright, a new personal best...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status 『Shock』 confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I can't take my eyes off the way Teio-san runs.
Positive emotions well up, ...meaning—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Analysis complete. Judgment confirmed. I have just received 'courage' from Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Pushing forward fearlessly through what people normally fear
and hesitate over—that strong resolve is the concept of "courage."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I inputted it because the words were related to "becoming an Umamusume who inspires courage."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san had...
'courage.'
Tokai Teio's back is still right in the line of Mihono Bourbon's gaze.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—"Courage" is so very warm,
and overflowing with power, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I now comprehend what it means to 'receive courage'.
Therefore, that is precisely why—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood the considerable amount of power
that one who bestows courage must possess...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Further physical enhancement deemed necessary.
Transitioning to training immediately.

That day's training was
more serious than ever.

After training was over.
Having forgotten something, I returned to the grounds to find—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup...!

I admire her stamina.
That said, it's about time for curfew.

Just as I open my mouth to call out to her—
another voice speaks up first.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're working hard pretty late, Tokai Teio.

(The student council president of Tracen Academy,
a strict Umamusume: Symboli Rudolf.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez! Hehehe, there's no way I wanna lose the upcoming Japan Cup, you see~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: They say Bourbon is running!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hoh, her, is it? Ever since entering the Classic class, she's been compared to you quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's why I got curious too!
So I went to watch the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then, I was totally glued to the screen.
Shocked, and so frustrated—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was just as thrilled!
I knew it was gonna be an amazing, fun race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, Prez, you've totally got to come watch!
I'm gonna show you what I've got!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I see. Got it.

Symboli Rudolf smiled gently at Tokai Teio,
who was chattering away excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm cheering for you, Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Ehehe...!
choice_data_list: (I didn't know she was worried about Bourbon...)

text_block_list.text:
I had no idea whatsoever.
I'm sure Mihono Bourbon doesn't know either.

Judging from how she looked during training,
she's definitely going to take this on with everything she's got.
Hearing her passionate feelings tightened my resolve once more.
